verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents is a Python/Node.js SDK plus self-hostable server that runs as a headless programmatic participant with no UI dependency; it's pip/npm-installable, has a built-in test framework (pytest/Vitest, agent simulations) suitable for CI, and the server/CLI were verified runtime to work keylessly. missing for 10: no explicit documented CI pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions config) or headless-mode confirmation beyond inference from server/testing docs.
